description:
A patient, Pedro Alva, has passed away. You need to update their records to reflect this status and manage their upcoming schedule.

1. Search for patient 'Pedro Alva'.
2. Update their demographics to mark them as 'Deceased' with the Date of Death: 2025-02-20.
3. Locate their upcoming 'Follow Up Visit' appointment (scheduled for 5 days from now at 10:00 AM) and Cancel it. Do not delete the appointment record; change its status to Canceled.

Login credentials: admin / password
